item.tib: sangs rgyas bka' yi pho nya khyab 'jug drang srong chen po'i ka bstod myur ba srog len
item.coloph: ces pa'i bstan srung khyab 'jug chen po'i ka bstod bstan dgra sgrol byed myur ba srog len zhes bya ba 'di yang / lha srung mnyes shing bstan dgra sgrol ba'i ched du/ ldong rigs kyi drang srong g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa spel ba'i cha rkyen du/ thos shar du bris te spel 'dis bstan dgra rtsad nas chod cing bon bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rgyur gyurd cig/
